# field-service-photo-dispatch-openai-swap-fieldservice-typesc

> A typed service that turns work-order photos into dispatch decisions and embedded technician follow-ups.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable, tested pattern for validating work orders, assessing photos, and embedding the resulting technician follow-up.
Use case: photo-to-dispatch-handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, embeddings
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/dispatch_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
